## Goal

Every PR through qew carries a ledger-held, machine-checked link declaration; merging lands the ledger exactly with no manual step. Design attached as design.md. Requested by Santa for the owner.

## Done when

pr open/link/unlink, ledger-only preflight, auto-land with land_pending repair, union aggregation, pr migrate, check audit shipped as 7.0.0 with minimum_version 7.0.0
seen.title: Mandatory PR link declaration (closes/remains/related/no-item), auto-land, qew 7.0.0
